rationale: Independently read Chilean parliamentary history body: Alessandri 1932–1938; Aguirre Cerda 1938–1941; Ríos 1942–1946; González Videla 1946–1952. Package deliberately uses complete interior years and preserves handover/interim gaps. Existing b09 source reused, not rediscovered; no existing leaders overlap. Political rights and authoritarian episodes are not flattened into blanket democracy.
